name: VR Car Showroom
summary:
Step into the future of automotive design with our immersive VR experience!

Choose from over 50 vehicles of various types and sizes — from classic icons to futuristic concepts. Explore every intricate detail in stunning photorealism: from sleek curves to powerful engines, it's like standing right in front of them. Zoom in, rotate, and inspect each vehicle from any angle.
